comment: Table 3.5 states LIMR definitions are "precise and unambiguous, leaving no room for reinterpretation by consuming systems," yet the requirement that would guarantee this, LIMR Req 10 "model-driven validation of data instances," is marked Recommended. As drafted, the no-reinterpretation claim is an aspiration, not an enforced property. This is the single mechanism that turns the LIMR from a specification catalogue into an enforcement point.
